title: SimpleCalc
description: A mod that adds a Calculator to Minecraft
body:
![SimpleCalc](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Dqe4CGFd/images/bb5bfd2a8038a9618daf89059fde9e014b085a6e_350.webp)

SimpleCalc is a lightweight and versatile calculator mod designed to fit naturally into your Minecraft experience.

It gives you multiple ways to perform calculations without ever leaving the game:

- Quick Access GUI – Open a clean, intuitive calculator interface anytime with a customizable keybind.
- Chat Calculations – Solve expressions directly in chat for fast, on-the-fly results.
- JEI Integration – If Just Enough Items is installed, you can even use the JEI search bar as a calculator.
SimpleCalc focuses on simplicity and speed, making it perfect for both casual players and technical modpacks. Whether you're managing resources, planning builds, or working with complex numbers, everything you need is always one keypress away.
